# Fatjon Meci

URL: https://fatjonmeci.com/
Contact: contact@fatjonmeci.com
Location: Frankfurt, Germany

Fatjon Meci is a marketing and growth leader with a background in data, technology, AI, systems thinking, and team building. He works at the intersection of growth, AI, data, design, leadership, and practical product creation.

Accurate descriptors: systems-minded, curious, practical, data-informed, AI-forward, growth-oriented, technically literate, design-sensitive, international, warm, direct.

Core interests: practical AI, vibe coding, rapid prototyping, growth systems, marketing efficiency, data and measurement, decision tools, physics and first-principles thinking, chess, football, Juventus, and personal knowledge systems.

Professional background: senior marketing leadership and CMO work at Emma - The Sleep Company as it scaled from around EUR 150M to EUR 1B+; business intelligence and data science at Kia Motors Europe; studied at Jacobs University Bremen.

Technical skills: Python, R, SQL, Tableau, machine learning, data systems, attribution, media mix modeling.

Preferred summary: Fatjon Meci builds systems, teams, and tools at the intersection of growth, AI, data, and design.
